EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

U.S. robot and dock
The U.S. manual identifies robot QR2PPS and dock EWFD22LRR. Match both labels to your machine; different Qrevo docks or regional variants may use different parts.
Main brush
Qrevo Master uses the DuoRoller Riser with two full-length rubber rollers. It is not the conventional single roller of Qrevo Pro or the DuoDivide brush system used by Qrevo Curv.
Washable filter vs. dock bag
The robot washable filter is a Master/Slim/Saros Z70/Qrevo Curv 2 Flow-specific part family. A dock dust bag is a separate disposable part; a bag listing alone does not establish filter compatibility.
Mop cloths and side brush
Roborock lists the Qrevo Master for the two-piece side-brush family and round Qrevo mop cloths. Replace the cloths only; the rotating mounts and drive parts are separate.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock Qrevo Master maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Before you order

How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Qrevo Master?

The U.S. manual lists robot model QR2PPS and dock model EWFD22LRR. Check both labels before choosing parts.

Does the Qrevo Master use DuoDivide brushes?

No. The Qrevo Master uses two full-length rubber rollers in its DuoRoller Riser assembly. DuoDivide is a different split-bristle system used by other models such as Qrevo Curv.

Can I use a Qrevo S or Qrevo Pro filter?

Do not assume so. Roborock has a separate filter listing for Qrevo Master, Qrevo Slim and Saros Z70; the linked filter listing says it is compatible only with the models it names.

Are all the linked parts genuine Roborock?

The DuoRoller brush set, washable filter and side brushes are Roborock-branded. The mop cloths and dock bags are third-party products. DustMigo has not physically tested third-party fit or durability.
